## Checks

- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally
- [ ] Looked at it in the gallery: 5 languages, 2 themes, households `before`, `after`, `demo`, `empty`
- [ ] Invented data only (screenshots included)
- [ ] Commits signed off (`git commit -s`)

### For a picture or a scene

- [ ] Every figure comes from the contract: the picture computes nothing, rounds nothing, invents nothing
- [ ] Colours from the `--bz-*` tokens only; readable in both themes and from 320 to 390 px, no text over text
- [ ] Motion respects `prefers-reduced-motion` and adds meaning (what moves is what changes)
- [ ] Screenshots before / after in the five languages
